In determining the timing and size of future adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate, the Committee will assess realized and expected economic conditions relative to its objectives of maximum employment and 2 percent inflation.

rate_path.rationale: Most participants saw gradual rate increases as appropriate, with a clear bias toward a slow, data-dependent path. The Committee emphasized waiting for more data and maintaining an accommodative stance, indicating a cautious, forward-looking bias toward easing policy only if conditions improved.
